nodes.label: Major Cities on Ganga
nodes.subject: geography
nodes.detail: Allahabad, Kanpur, Varanasi, Lucknow, Patna, Kolkata - all with population exceeding ten lakhs. Wastewater from cities and industries causes river pollution. Kolkata is important port on Hooghly.
nodes.chapter_title: Human Environment Interactions: Tropical and Subtropical Region

nodes.label: Ganga Tributaries
nodes.subject: geography
nodes.detail: Major tributaries include Ghaghra, Son, Chambal, Gandak, Kosi. Together with Brahmaputra tributaries, they drain the entire basin. Form fertile alluvial plains ideal for agriculture.
nodes.chapter_title: Human Environment Interactions: Tropical and Subtropical Region

nodes.label: Paddy Cultivation
nodes.subject: geography
nodes.detail: Main crop of Ganga-Brahmaputra basin. Requires sufficient water and high rainfall. Other crops: wheat, maize, sorghum, gram, millets. Cash crops: sugarcane, jute. Tea grown in Assam and West Bengal.
